findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 3 projects, synced last week." followed by a `<ul>` with only two `<li>` items ("Data Warehouse Cutover", "Mobile App Revamp")
findings.fix: Either list all 3 projects, change the count to match the list, or add a label/affordance (e.g., "recent" heading, "+1 more" link) clarifying that the list is a subset.
findings.violation: The stated project count (3) doesn't match the number of projects actually listed (2), with no indication that the list is partial.

findings.fix: Add visible label text (e.g., "Duplicate project") or at minimum an `aria-label="Duplicate project"`.

findings.evidence: Overview lists "Data Warehouse Cutover" and "Mobile App Revamp", but the project settings opened via `#workspace-overview-projects-link` shows `value="Design System Refresh"`
findings.fix: Either add "Design System Refresh" to the overview's project list, or make the "Open project settings" link target a specific, listed project.
findings.violation: The project name shown in Project Settings doesn't correspond to either project listed on the workspace overview, so it's unclear which project "Open project settings" is supposed to open.
